title: Principle 1: every claim depends on information in the brain

statements.text: Information that comes out of a brain must have been in that brain. Nobody can believe or claim a proposition unless it is represented by information in a form and place that can reach the systems for belief and report, so the belief in subjective experience requires information that depicts it.

sources.quote: Information that comes out of a brain must have been in that brain.
The principle is, in a sense, a computational conservation of information.
